name: Caleb
summary: A spy from the tribe of Judah who trusted the LORD when others were afraid. Because he followed the LORD with his whole heart, he lived to receive Hebron as his inheritance.

key_moments.title: Urges Israel to Take the Land
key_moments.description: Caleb quieted the people in front of Moses and told them to go up at once, for they could surely win. With Joshua, he urged them not to rebel against the LORD or fear the people living there.

key_moments.title: Promised He Will Enter the Land
key_moments.description: The LORD said Caleb had another spirit in him and had followed Him fully. So Caleb would enter the land, and his children would possess it.

key_moments.title: Asks for Hebron at Eighty-Five
key_moments.description: At eighty-five, Caleb told Joshua he was as strong as when Moses sent him to spy, and asked for the hill country the LORD had promised. Joshua blessed him and gave him Hebron.

key_moments.title: Gives Achsah the Springs
key_moments.description: Caleb drove Anak's three sons out of Hebron and promised his daughter Achsah to whoever took Kirjathsepher. Othniel took it and married her, and Caleb gave her the upper and lower springs she asked for.
